title: tau configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/tau/config.json. All keys are optional; unknown keys are rejected here so typos surface in editors, even though tau itself ignores them. See docs/configuration.md for the full reference.

$schema.description: Optional editor binding for this schema. Ignored by tau.

provider.description: LLM provider name; must match an entry in the built-in provider table (tau models).

model.description: Model id, or 'provider/id' shorthand. Defaults to the provider's default model.

api_key.description: Global fallback API key. Sits below per-provider 'keys' in precedence; prefer env vars to keep secrets out of files.

keys.description: Per-provider API keys: provider name -> key string. Outranks the global api_key. Non-string values are skipped by tau.

stream.description: SSE token streaming. Set false for batch/non-interactive use (--no-stream).

debug.description: Log perf stats and tool I/O to stderr (--debug).

max_tokens.description: Cap on output tokens (--max-tokens). Omit for uncapped.

context_window.description: Token capacity used for the compaction threshold (--context-window). Defaults per provider.

auto_compact.description: Auto-compact history when it grows too large (--no-compact disables).

compact_threshold.description: Fraction of context_window that triggers compaction (--compact-threshold).

compact_keep_recent_tokens.description: Recent tokens kept verbatim during compaction (--compact-keep-recent).

goal_max_iterations.description: Per-run agentic loop cap in /goal mode (--goal-max-iterations).

goal_max_continues.description: Cross-invocation continuation cap for goal mode (no CLI flag).
